name: code-yeongyu-pi-openai-code-interpreter
description: OpenAI native code interpreter policy extension for the pi coding agent. Ensures native code_interpreter tools are present on Responses API payloads when opt-in is enabled and appends code interpreter guidance to the system prompt.
